CIVIL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION

 Transfer Petition(s)(Civil) No.2092/2019

 VANDANA SINGH Petitioner

 VERSUS

 PRASHANT KUMAR Respondent

 O R D E R
The parties signed the final deed of settlement dated

 24th February, 2021. An amendment agreement dated

 28th September, 2021 to the said final deed of settlement is placed

 on record by the Supreme Court Mediation Centre.
In view of the settlement, the Transfer Petition is disposed

 of.
.................................J.
 [ABHAY S. OKA]

 NEW DELHI;
DECEMBER 03, 2021

Reason:
